_doc: Canonical constants for the Kalshi bot factory. Everything numeric that the backtester or the gate depends on lives here, so a value is never corrected in one module and left stale in another. Same role tuning.json plays for the game.
_UNVERIFIED: fees.taker_rate and the maker schedule are from general knowledge, NOT from a live read of Kalshi's fee schedule (this environment has no network access to kalshi.com). The fee formula is the single largest determinant of whether ANY strategy here is profitable. Re-read https://kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf and correct this file before trusting a single result. See kalshi/README.md 'What is unverified'.

fees.taker_formula: ceil_to_cent(rate * contracts * price * (1 - price)), price in dollars

microstructure._maker_fill_note: Probability a resting order at or inside the touch fills from uninformed flow in a step where price did NOT move through it. Pure guess. Market-making results are only as good as this number.

gate._doc: The definition of 'proven profit'. A bot must clear EVERY line to pass. Loosening any of these is how a bot factory lies to itself.
gate._min_annual_dollars_note: Criterion 11. Set above the incumbent so a new winner has to be a better BUSINESS, not just a better edge. Scales linearly with capacity.markets_per_year — COUNTED for econ_print (see census.py), still an estimate for every other family.

capacity._doc: How many markets of each family the exchange plausibly lists per year. ESTIMATES, from general knowledge of what Kalshi runs — not scraped, not verified. They convert a percentage return into dollars per year, which is the only number that says whether a bot is a business. Wrong by 2x here means wrong by 2x there, so correct them against the real market list before planning around any of it.
capacity._econ_print_is_COUNTED_not_estimated: 534 = 2,668 settled contracts / 5.0 years (Jul 2021-Jun 2026, 8 series), from 'Information Efficiency Across Macroeconomic Prediction Markets: Evidence from Kalshi'. A LOWER bound: 8 series only, and the window includes Kalshi's small years. See kalshi/census.py and CENSUS.md. Every OTHER family below is still an unverified estimate.
capacity._markets_per_year_basis: crypto_hourly: ~2 series x 24h x 365. index_bracket_daily: ~3 indices x 252 sessions. econ_print: CPI/payrolls/Fed/PCE/GDP/retail ~70 releases x a few strikes. weather_temp: ~10 cities x 365. sports_game: NFL+NBA+MLB+NHL regular seasons. politics/awards/mentions: rough counts of what tends to be listed.
capacity._peak_note: Concurrent positions modelled as Poisson; capital required is mean + peak_sigma*sqrt(mean) positions. Determines return on capital you must COMMIT rather than capital you happen to be using.

seeds._doc: Disjoint by construction. An episode drawn for in-sample can never appear in OOS or holdout, which is the only thing making the OOS number mean anything.
